metaData.title: Copper Ridge Youth Foundation autumn events check in

sentences.text: Afternoon. You have four events between now and the end of November, so I thought a session was overdue.
Afternoon. Five now, we added a sports day at the end of October last week.
Five then. Where are they being held?
All five are in school buildings, which is how nearly everything we run works.
Two school gyms, a cafeteria, a sports field and one community hall that used to be a school.
We go to where the young people already are, because asking families to travel to us loses about half of them.
That makes sense for your programme. How many people at each?
Between eighty and three hundred. The sports day will be the biggest and the reading night the smallest.
And how are you signing people in at those?
Badly, and this is the thing I most wanted to talk about.
We want something our volunteers can run on their own phones to sign people in at the door, because the kiosks do not travel to a school gym.
There is rarely a spare table, almost never a power socket where we need one, and last month a gym teacher unplugged ours to charge a scoreboard.
Our volunteers all have a phone in their pocket and they all know how to use it, and that is the only piece of equipment I can count on.
Let me be precise about this before I take it anywhere. You are not asking for the kiosk to work better, you are asking for something different in its place.
Something different, yes. The kiosk is right for a conference hall and wrong for a school corridor.
Four or five volunteers each signing in their own queue on their own phone is what the evening actually looks like.
That is a distinct thing and I will write it up as one rather than folding it into the kiosk conversation.
I would appreciate that. They get treated as the same request and they are not the same request.
Understood. On a related note, how is the safeguarding paperwork handled at these?
On paper, deliberately, and that is one thing we are not looking to change this year.
Every volunteer is checked before the season and the forms live in a locked cabinet in our office.
Our board is comfortable with that and I am not going to reopen it in the middle of an events season.
That is a sensible place to leave it. I only asked because it comes up with foundations like yours.
It comes up constantly, and the answer is always the same.
One action for me then, the sign in request written up on its own terms.
Good luck with the sports day.
Thank you. Ask me in November how it went and I will tell you the truth.
